Usage: spec-driven-steroids clean [options]

Remove globally injected Spec-Driven Steroids

Options:
  --global               Clean global steroids from all platforms (default)
  --project              Clean project-level steroids in the current directory
  --platform <platform>  Limit cleanup to one platform
  --force                Remove files even if they were modified after
                         installation
  --dry-run              Show what would be removed without deleting anything
  --json                 Emit a machine-readable JSON summary
  -y, --yes              Skip confirmation prompt
  -h, --help             display help for command
